newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26) for a MISS order for 2026-27 (RBI, DFS, PIB): none found. The latest official order is RBI/2025-26/193 of 13 Jan 2026 (cited; FY 2025-26: Rs 3 lakh at 7%, 3% prompt repayment incentive, Rs 2 lakh allied-only sub-limit). News (Aug 2026) reports a 2026-27 budget allocation of Rs 22,600 crore and talks of a 50 bp cut in the subvention to banks, with farmers still at 7%: not decided. RBI's revised KCC Directions are deferred to 1 Jan 2027 and exclude MISS.

findings.note: The Rs 5 lakh claims are gone. Every amount now matches a quoted fact: Rs 3 lakh at 7% and 4% for prompt repayment (RBI §2(i)-(ii) and PIB), Rs 2 lakh sub-limit for allied-only farmers (RBI §2(iii)), collateral-free Rs 2 lakh from 1 Jan 2025 (PIB). The rates are dated '(2025-26)'; today is FY 2026-27, for which no MISS order has been published yet.
findings.suggestion: When the 2026-27 MISS circular is issued, cite it and update the year. Until then the dated wording is honest; keep reverify_days at 120 or lower.

findings.note: Marked optional (cited to PIB), but the RBI circular §3(i) says 'Aadhaar seeding and authentication are mandatory for availing benefits under the scheme' (the interest subvention).
findings.suggestion: Cite rbi_miss_2025_26 for aadhaar and say in how_to_apply that Aadhaar e-KYC is needed for the interest help; or make it mandatory.

findings.note: Text now matches the logic and confidence is 'uncertain', so dairy and fisheries workers see 'check with the bank'. The cost is that salaried and other clearly non-farm users also get NEED_MORE_INFO rather than NOT_ELIGIBLE. Acceptable for an uncertain rule.
The PIB backgrounder still contains the unsupported 'Rs 3 lakh to Rs 5 lakh' MISS claim; the scheme no longer relies on it.
findings.suggestion: Prefer the RBI circular for any future interest facts.
